correctness.rationale: For fixed r and each fixed round horizon the integrated-exposure direct-adoption probability expands as p f_nu(tau) (rho Theta/N)+O(N^-2 Theta^2), so conditional Poisson splitting with surviving parents gives offspring Z=1{E>=tau}+Poisson(c min(E,tau)) with *dependent* survival/contact via common E. Its PGF G(s)=lambda(1-e^{-[lambda+c(1-s)]tau})/[lambda+c(1-s)]+s e^{-[lambda+c(1-s)]tau}. I independently symbolically substituted s=lambda/c and simplified G(s)-s=0, computed G'(1)=1+kappa(c/lambda-1) and G''(1)|c=lambda=2kappa. Strictly convex PGF gives q=min(1,lambda/c). For each fixed K, from 1..K-1 adopters a next-round-extinction probability bounded below by kappa^(K-1)exp(-2rho K tau), giving a uniform geometric stopping tail and passage from finite-horizon convergence to K-first-passage law. Then K increases. At criticality the offspring span is one and finite variance 2kappa; Dwass cyclic identity plus aperiodic local CLT gives n^-3/2/(2sqrt(pi kappa)) and n^-1/2/sqrt(pi kappa). No fixed-N eternal survival or macroscopic-outbreak assertion.
